verse.text: How joyful are those who fear the LORD— all who follow his ways! You will enjoy the fruit of your labor. How joyful and prosperous you will be!

video.title: Psalm 128:1–6 — Blessed Are Those Who Fear the LORD (NASB)

reflection: A godly man isn't measured by how much he accomplishes but by whether he walks in step with the Lord — and Psalm 128 promises that when a man does, his home becomes a place of real joy, not just busyness. Your labor matters, but it's meant to produce fruit at the family table, not just a paycheck. Let today's work be an act of worship that your kids can actually see and feel.
